page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable instruction blocks. Link them to agents — order sets the order they appear in the prompt.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is a block of instructions an agent reuses. Write one, or import a markdown file or archive.

card.agentCount: {count, plural, =0 {no agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}

delete.title: Delete this skill?
delete.body: "{name}" will be unlinked from every agent that uses it and its version history will be removed. This cannot be undone.

detail.usedBy: Used by {count, plural, =0 {no agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}

previewTab.heading: Preview
previewTab.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
previewTab.empty: This skill has no body yet.

versions.heading: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every save snapshots the body, so a version always shows the exact text the agent was given.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore the body of v{version}? The current text is kept as its own version, so this adds history rather than erasing it.
versions.diffTitle: v{version} compared with the current body (v{current})
versions.identical: This version is identical to the current body.

editor.subtitle: A skill is configuration text. It is added to the prompt of every agent that uses it — nothing in it is ever executed.

fields.name: Name
fields.nameHint: Short and kebab-case reads best in the agent's skill list.
fields.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface — it says when the skill applies. Write it as an instruction, e.g. “Flag tests that cover only the happy path.”
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag tests that cover only the happy path
fields.typeHint: Grouping only — it does not change how the skill is applied.
fields.bodyHint: The text the model actually receives. Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

drawer.title: Import a skill
drawer.subtitle: From a markdown file, an archive, or a URL
drawer.fileHint: From an archive only the skill document is read. Scripts and binaries are listed below and never opened.
drawer.trustNotice: This is someone else's text. Once enabled it becomes part of your agent's prompt, so read it before you switch it on — it is stored as untrusted data and wrapped as such in the prompt.
drawer.skippedTitle: {count} archive entries skipped — not read, not executed

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side behind private-address and size guards, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
